title: Fold Aggregation and Discrepancy Forensic Audit
description: Per-fold 3x3 confusion matrices, class supports, recalls, unweighted fold means, and mathematical explanation of pooled vs fold-mean Balanced Accuracy.

mathematical_reconciliation.formula_pooled: BA_pooled = (1/3) * sum_{c} [ sum_{k=1}^K w_k(c) * Recall_k(c) ], where w_k(c) = N_k(c) / N_total(c)
mathematical_reconciliation.mechanism: Class support across folds is highly heterogeneous due to market regime shifts. Low-volatility folds have high EXP support (~11,000 candles) and high EXP recall (~80%). High-volatility folds have low EXP support (~900 candles) and low EXP recall (~5%). In unweighted fold-mean, the low-recall fold receives equal 20% weight, severely penalizing the mean. In pooled BA, each fold's recall is weighted by its actual sample share w_k(c), accurately reflecting aggregate performance.
mathematical_reconciliation.aggregation_phenomenon_classification: Non-stationary support-weighted macro-aggregation effect. There is no reversal of relative model rankings across sub-groups; B4 outperforms B0 in every fold. The difference is strictly a support-weighted macro aggregation effect caused by regime-dependent class frequencies.
